sourceLineage.origin: SQM investor relations — Q2 2026 earnings release
Reuters — SQM shares rise after earnings beat, higher lithium outlook

observations: SQM reported Q2 revenue about $2.468B, gross profit $1.260B and net income $660M, with quarterly lithium sales above 84.1k metric tons LCE and realized lithium price about $21.8/kg.

Reuters independently reported that the quarter beat expectations and that SQM raised its 2026 lithium demand outlook, confirming that reported execution exceeded contemporaneous market expectations rather than merely improving year over year.
factors: record lithium volume and materially stronger realized pricing
BESS demand broadens lithium demand beyond BEVs
earnings beat plus raised demand outlook provides an expectations-execution positive signal
risks: lithium earnings remain highly cyclical and price-sensitive
multi-year expansion capital precedes expected Mt Holland production
current earnings strength may overstate normalized cycle economics
contradictions: Strong current pricing and an expectations beat coexist with slower-than-expected BEV growth and management emphasis on production flexibility.
unknowns: normalized lithium price/margin through a full cycle
durability of the raised demand outlook if BESS growth slows
execution economics and ramp profile for Mt Holland/Kwinana

recommendation.reason: Independent Reuters expectations evidence now corroborates the issuer operating evidence and is directly reusable by Alpha without Scout assigning a numeric score.
